name: loop
source: fn main() -> i32 { var i = 0; var s = 0; while i < 10 { s = s + i; i = i + 1; } print_i32(s); return 0; }

name: zero-trip
source: fn main() -> i32 { var s = 7; while false { s = 99; } print_i32(s); return 0; }

name: shadow
source: fn main() -> i32 { let x = 3; { let x = x + 1; print_i32(x); }; print_i32(x); return 0; }

name: short-circuit
source: fn boom() -> bool { trap(9); return true; } fn main() -> i32 { print_bool(false && boom()); print_bool(true || boom()); return 0; }

name: selected-branch
source: fn main() -> i32 { let x = if true { 5 } else { 1 / 0 }; print_i32(x); return 0; }

name: recursive-forward
source: fn main() -> i32 { print_i32(fact(5)); return 0; } fn fact(n: i32) -> i32 { if n == 0 { return 1; }; return n * fact(n - 1); }

name: argument-order
source: fn mark(x: i32) -> i32 { print_i32(x); return x; } fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { return a + b; } fn main() -> i32 { print_i32(add(mark(1), mark(2))); return 0; }

name: return-merge
source: fn choose(x: bool) -> i32 { let y = if x { return 7; } else { 9 }; return y; } fn main() -> i32 { print_i32(choose(true)); print_i32(choose(false)); return 0; }

name: immutable
source: fn main() -> i32 { let x = 1; x = 2; return 0; }

name: type-mismatch
source: fn main() -> i32 { let x: bool = 1; return 0; }

name: arity
source: fn f(x: i32) -> i32 { return x; } fn main() -> i32 { return f(); }

name: duplicate
source: fn f(x: i32) -> i32 { let x = 2; return x; }

name: call-shadow
source: fn f() -> i32 { return 1; } fn main() -> i32 { let f = 2; return f(); }
